assets.concept: You can follow a family recipe exactly and still miss the inherited flavour carried by its cooking oil. The execution makes Filtered Groundnut Oil the specific decision, not a logo placed beside category content.

assets.sendTo: The sibling who keeps trying to recreate their mother's poha
assets.strategicRole: Turn recipes-serving into a brand-owned argument.
